drafts-zu-01-001.text: Isibhakabhaka sithulile, nolayini uthulile. UMsombuluko awukayitholi ivolumu.
drafts-zu-01-001.en: The sky's on mute and so is the queue. Monday hasn't found the volume.

drafts-zu-01-002.text: Isibhakabhaka nolwandle kuvumelene ngombala ekuseni. Akuwona umbala ojabulisayo.
drafts-zu-01-002.en: Sky and sea agreed on a colour this morning. Not an exciting one.

drafts-zu-01-003.text: Ngisho ne-hadeda ithule. Isibhakabhaka yisona esibeke isimo.
drafts-zu-01-003.en: Even the hadeda is keeping it down. The sky set the tone.

drafts-zu-01-004.text: Azikho izithunzi, akukho ukukhazimula, azikho izaba. UMsombuluko ungaphansi kwesivalo se-Tupperware.
drafts-zu-01-004.en: No shadows, no glare, no excuses. Monday under a Tupperware lid.

drafts-zu-01-005.text: Ilanga ngeke lize lizohlola ukukhazimula namuhla. Imoto ayinankinga ngalokho.
drafts-zu-01-005.en: The sun won't be inspecting the shine today. The car is fine with that.

drafts-zu-01-006.text: Asikho nesisodwa isithunzi enkundleni usuku lonke. Unompempe akazange avale amehlo ngenxa yelanga.
drafts-zu-01-006.en: Not one shadow on the field all day. The umpire never had to squint.

drafts-zu-01-007.text: Isibhakabhaka esimpunga, amajezi agqokiwe, isikole siphumile. Impelasonto ayidingi imvume yelanga.
drafts-zu-01-007.en: Grey sky, jerseys on, school's out. The weekend doesn't need the sun's permission.

drafts-zu-01-008.text: Ithafa lonke linombala owehlisiwe. Inani lezimvu liyafana noma kunjani.
drafts-zu-01-008.en: The whole veld with the colour turned down. The sheep count the same either way.

drafts-zu-01-009.text: Isibani esibayeni yikho ukushona kwelanga kulobu busuku. Izinkomo ziyakwamukela ukwehliswa.
drafts-zu-01-009.en: The shed bulb is tonight's sunset. The cattle accept the downgrade.

drafts-zu-01-010.text: Isibhakabhaka sisuke empunga ekhanyayo saya empunga emnyama. Yilowo wonke umbukiso.
drafts-zu-01-010.en: The sky went from light grey to dark grey. That was the whole show.

drafts-zu-01-011.text: Isibani sezokuphepha sikhanyise kusenesikhathi. Ilanga alizange liqale umsebenzi kahle.
drafts-zu-01-011.en: The security light came on early. The sun never properly clocked in.

drafts-zu-01-012.text: Ulwandle nesibhakabhaka kumpunga ngokufanayo. Izibani zasesikhumulweni kuphela ezizamile.
drafts-zu-01-012.en: Sea and sky in matching grey. Only the pier lights made an effort.

drafts-zu-01-013.text: Ifulegi linikeza isibikezelo ngaphambi kwabagibeli bamagagasi. Lithi: hambani.
drafts-zu-01-013.en: The flag's giving the forecast before the surfers do. It says: go.

drafts-zu-01-014.text: Izimbali ze-jacaranda nazo zigibela ibhasi. Umoya omncane uzithengele amathikithi.
drafts-zu-01-014.en: The jacaranda petals are taking the bus too. The breeze bought their tickets.

drafts-zu-01-015.text: Impompi yomoya yenza umsebenzi wasekuseni. Utshani buyayikhuthaza nje.
drafts-zu-01-015.en: The windpump is doing the morning's work. The grass is just waving it on.

drafts-zu-01-016.text: Isandla ekepisini, isinyathelo ngesinyathelo. Umoya omncane uhamba naye.
drafts-zu-01-016.en: Hand on the cap, one stride at a time. The breeze is pacing her.

drafts-zu-01-017.text: Izingubo zizobe zomile ngaphambi kwekhefu lokuqala. Umoya omncane uqale umsebenzi kusenesikhathi.
drafts-zu-01-017.en: The washing will be dry before first break. The breeze took the early shift.

drafts-zu-01-018.text: Isivunguvungu esincane sothuli sihamba phambi kwakhe. Futhi asizihluphi ngokushova.
drafts-zu-01-018.en: A little dust devil is riding ahead of him. It isn't even pedalling.

drafts-zu-01-019.text: Izinwele zakhe zifike kuqala esitolo sesinkwa. Umoya omncane unezinhlelo zawo zangeSonto.
drafts-zu-01-019.en: Her hair got to the bakery first. The breeze has its own Sunday plans.

drafts-zu-01-020.text: Yisikhathi sekhefu, futhi umoya omncane ulungisa izinwele zabo bonke. Nothisha.
drafts-zu-01-020.en: Break time, and the breeze is doing everyone's hair. Teachers included.

drafts-zu-01-021.text: Umoya omncane usebenza etafuleni lezithelo namuhla. I-air-con ifakiwe, ayikho imali eyengeziwe.
drafts-zu-01-021.en: The breeze is working the fruit stall today. Air-con included, no extra charge.

drafts-zu-01-022.text: Umoya wenza wonke umsebenzi. I-kite ithatha lonke udumo.
drafts-zu-01-022.en: The breeze does all the work. The kite takes all the credit.

drafts-zu-01-023.text: Ifulegi lasekhoneni likhomba ngqo lapho ibhola lizophambukela khona.
drafts-zu-01-023.en: The corner flag is pointing out exactly where the conversions will drift.

drafts-zu-01-024.text: Amashidi asomile kakade. Manje umoya omncane uziqhayisa nje enganeni.
drafts-zu-01-024.en: The sheets are dry already. Now the breeze is just showing off for the kid.

drafts-zu-01-025.text: Intuthu ifike egcekeni labomakhelwane. Ibraai yangoMgqibelo manje ingumcimbi womphakathi ngokusemthethweni.
drafts-zu-01-025.en: The smoke has found the neighbours' yard. Saturday's braai is officially a community event.

drafts-zu-01-026.text: Izicathulo emakhoneni engubo. Umoya omncane uyamukeleka, isihlabathi asamukeleki.
drafts-zu-01-026.en: Shoes on the blanket corners. The breeze is welcome, the sand isn't.

drafts-zu-01-027.text: Amafulegi aqonde ngqo, iwayini libanjwe ngokuqinile. Yile ndlela i-deck ebona ngayo uMsombuluko ozolile.
drafts-zu-01-027.en: Flags out straight, wine held tight. The deck's version of a calm Monday.

drafts-zu-01-028.text: Uthuli lukhazimula njengegolide ekukhanyeni kokushona kwelanga. Umdlalo uyaqhubeka.
drafts-zu-01-028.en: The dust is going for gold in the low light. The match plays on through it.

drafts-zu-01-029.text: Igquma linyakaza ngamagagasi. Izinkomo zinqume ukungaboni lutho.
drafts-zu-01-029.en: The hill is moving in waves. The cattle have decided not to notice.

drafts-zu-01-030.text: Umoya omncane uthutha i-jacaranda iye komunye umgwaqo, imbali ngembali. I-stoep iyavuma.
drafts-zu-01-030.en: The breeze is moving the jacaranda one street over, petal by petal. The stoep approves.

drafts-zu-01-031.text: Izingubo bezifanele zingene emahoreni adlule. Umoya omncane uvote ukuthi zisale.
drafts-zu-01-031.en: The washing should have come in hours ago. The breeze voted to leave it.

drafts-zu-01-032.en: The flags are still chatting. The boats have called it a week.

drafts-zu-01-033.text: Amaqabunga ahlala ekhanyisa isibani sezokuphepha. Inja ayisasukumi ngenxa yawo.
drafts-zu-01-033.en: The leaves keep setting off the security light. The dog's stopped getting up for them.

drafts-zu-01-034.text: Othile ukhohliwe izingubo. Umoya omncane wona awukhohlwanga, futhi wenza umsebenzi omuhle.
drafts-zu-01-034.en: Somebody forgot the washing. The breeze didn't, and it's doing a lovely job.

drafts-zu-01-035.text: Umoya omncane usafudumele ngalesi sikhathi. Ulwandle lushiya isifudumezi sivuliwe ubusuku bonke.
drafts-zu-01-035.en: The breeze is still warm at this hour. The sea leaves the heating on all night.

drafts-zu-01-036.text: Impompi yomoya ayikholelwa esikhathini sokuphuma emsebenzini. Nenja ayikholelwa kuso.
drafts-zu-01-036.en: The windpump doesn't believe in knock-off time. Neither does the dog.

drafts-zu-01-037.text: Umoya omncane uthwala intuthu wehle nomgwaqo. Wonke umgwaqo uyazi ukuthi kudliwani kusihlwa.
drafts-zu-01-037.en: The breeze is taking the smoke down the block. The whole street knows what's for supper.

drafts-zu-01-038.text: Zonke izibani ezisentanjeni ziyanyakaza. UMgqibelo ebusuku unesigqi, kancane nje.
drafts-zu-01-038.en: Every light on the string is swaying. Saturday night has rhythm, barely.

drafts-zu-01-039.text: Isihlabathi siwela umgwaqo inhlamvu ngenhlamvu. Akekho lapha ojahile.
drafts-zu-01-039.en: The sand is crossing the road a grain at a time. Nobody here is in a hurry.

drafts-zu-01-040.text: Intaba izembese ingubo ekhanda. Kulungile, nguLwesihlanu.
drafts-zu-01-040.en: The mountain pulled the duvet over its head. Fair enough, it's Friday.

drafts-zu-01-041.text: Ilanga liyangena, liyaphuma. UMsombuluko uqala kancane.
drafts-zu-01-041.en: Sun's in, sun's out. Monday's doing a soft launch.

drafts-zu-01-042.text: Amafu anike ilanga ikhefu ngoLwesibili. Akekho otshele umswakama.
drafts-zu-01-042.en: The clouds gave the sun Tuesday off. Nobody told the humidity.

drafts-zu-01-043.text: Lawo mafu adlula nje. Ngisho nommbila uyazi ukuthi akufanele ujabule.
drafts-zu-01-043.en: Those clouds are only passing through. Even the mealies know not to get excited.

drafts-zu-01-044.text: Umthunzi uhamba emigqeni, owodwa ngowodwa. Uyahlola.
drafts-zu-01-044.en: The shade is working down the rows one at a time. It's inspecting.

drafts-zu-01-045.text: I-purple phansi, okumhlophe esibhakabhakeni. Imibala kaLwesihlanu yamukelwe.
drafts-zu-01-045.en: Purple on the ground, white in the sky. Friday's colour scheme is approved.

drafts-zu-01-046.text: Amafu ambalwa eze ukuzobuka. Nawo awagijimi.
drafts-zu-01-046.en: A few clouds came along to watch. Also not running.

drafts-zu-01-047.en: The clouds are drifting through slowly. It's Sunday; they're allowed.

drafts-zu-01-048.text: Indwangu yetafula yentaba igqokwe uhhafu kuphela. NguMsombuluko, akekho ogqoke ngokuphelele.
drafts-zu-01-048.en: The mountain's tablecloth is only half on. It's Monday, nobody's fully dressed.

drafts-zu-01-049.text: Izithunzi zamafu zihamba kancane ziwela inkundla. Akekho okhalazayo.
drafts-zu-01-049.en: Cloud shadows crossing the outfield at a steady walk. Nobody's appealing.

drafts-zu-01-050.text: Ilanga, bese kuba ifu, bese kuba ilanga. Ngisho nezinkawu azikwazi ukuhlela ngalokho.
drafts-zu-01-050.en: Sun, then cloud, then sun. Even the monkeys can't plan around that.

drafts-zu-01-051.text: Inja ithole umngcele ngqo phakathi kwelanga nomthunzi. Ihlala khona.
drafts-zu-01-051.en: The dog found the exact line between sun and shade. He's staying put.

drafts-zu-01-052.text: Izibuko zelanga ziyagqokwa, ziyakhunyulwa, ziyagqokwa. ULwesihlanu ntambama kungukuzivocavoca.
drafts-zu-01-052.en: Sunglasses on, sunglasses off, sunglasses on. Friday afternoon is interval training.

drafts-zu-01-053.text: Ifu elilodwa phezu kwentaba alisona isimo sezulu. Umlilo uqhubeka uvutha.
drafts-zu-01-053.en: One cloud over the mountain is not a weather event. The fire stays lit.

drafts-zu-01-054.text: Ifu phezu kwentaba, i-potjie ngaphansi kwe-lapa. Kokubili kusadinga elinye ihora.
drafts-zu-01-054.en: Cloud over the mountain, potjie under the lapa. Both need another hour.

drafts-zu-01-055.text: Amafu ahlale isikhathi eside ngenxa yombala kuphela. UMsombuluko ubukweleta wonke umuntu lokho.
drafts-zu-01-055.en: The clouds stayed late just for the colour. Monday owed everyone that much.

drafts-zu-01-056.text: Amafu ntambama yonke, akukho ngisho nethonsi. Ipayipi lamanzi libuyele emsebenzini.
drafts-zu-01-056.en: Clouds all afternoon, not a drop. The hose is back on duty.

drafts-zu-01-057.text: Isibhakabhaka senza umbukiso. Izinhlanzi, njengenjwayelo, azenzi.
drafts-zu-01-057.en: The sky's putting on a show. The fish, as usual, are not.

drafts-zu-01-058.text: Amafu okushona kwelanga, amanzi okunisela amagilebhisi. Ipulazi lizilungiselela imvula yalo.
drafts-zu-01-058.en: Clouds for the sunset, sprinklers for the vines. The farm arranges its own rain.

drafts-zu-01-059.text: Ilanga seliphumile emsebenzini. Amafu asakhanya, ne-balcony nayo.
drafts-zu-01-059.en: The sun's clocked out. The clouds are still lit, and so is the balcony.

drafts-zu-01-060.text: Amafu aphenduke abe yi-pink ngqo ngesikhathi sokupakisha. Akekho opakishile.
drafts-zu-01-060.en: The clouds turned pink right on packing-up time. Nobody packed up.

drafts-zu-01-061.text: Izinkomo sezisekhaya ngaphambi kokuba umbala uphele. ISonto liphela ngesikhathi ngqo.
drafts-zu-01-061.en: The cattle are home before the colour goes. Sunday ends exactly on schedule.

drafts-zu-01-062.text: Inyanga ikhanya kancane kulobu busuku. Isibani sezokuphepha asinalo lelo khono.
drafts-zu-01-062.en: The moon's on a dimmer tonight. The security light has no such setting.

drafts-zu-01-063.text: Uhhafu wenyanga, uhhafu wefu, umgqomo ugcwele. NguLwesibili ebusuku, njengoba kumenyezelwe.
drafts-zu-01-063.en: Half moon, half cloud, full bin. Tuesday night, as advertised.

drafts-zu-01-064.text: Inyanga ihlala iphuma izobheka igaraji likaphethiloli. Akukho okwenzekayo.
drafts-zu-01-064.en: The moon keeps popping out to check on the forecourt. Still nothing happening.

drafts-zu-01-065.text: Amafu adlulisela inyanga komunye nomunye. I-balcony iyajabula ukulinda.
drafts-zu-01-065.en: The clouds are passing the moon around. The balcony is happy to wait.

drafts-zu-01-066.text: Inyanga ivakashela phakathi kwamafu. Iyalizwa iphunga lenyama isezulwini.
drafts-zu-01-066.en: The moon drops in between clouds. It can smell the meat from up there.

drafts-zu-01-067.text: Uhhafu wezinkanyezi ungemuva kwamafu. Izibani ezincane ziyazimela.
drafts-zu-01-067.en: Half the stars are behind cloud. The fairy lights are covering for them.

drafts-zu-01-068.text: Inyanga ingemuva kwefu, inja iku-stoep. Inkonzo yangeSonto iphelile.
drafts-zu-01-068.en: Moon behind a cloud, dog on the stoep. Sunday's service is over.

drafts-zu-01-069.text: Ngu-6 ekuseni kanti ifriji isivele iyindawo ethandwa kakhulu endlini.
drafts-zu-01-069.en: It's 6am and the fridge is already the most popular room in the house.

drafts-zu-01-070.text: Inja iyawuthanda lo moya. Yiyona yodwa enesitayela sezinwele esenzelwe wona.
drafts-zu-01-070.en: The dog is loving this wind. He's got the only hairstyle built for it.

drafts-zu-01-071.text: Kubanda impela namuhla. Uhlobo olungena emajezini amathathu sengathi awekho.
drafts-zu-01-071.en: Properly cold today. The kind that goes through three jerseys like they aren't there.

drafts-zu-01-072.text: Ngisho nalabo abafunga ukuthi akuze kubande bayavuma manje.
drafts-zu-01-072.en: Even the people who swear it never gets cold are admitting it.

drafts-zu-01-073.text: Umama womuntu othile uzothethisa. Kodwa bekumnandi.
drafts-zu-01-073.en: Somebody's mom is going to have words. Worth it.

drafts-zu-01-074.en: The sun is buffering. Do not refresh the page.

drafts-zu-01-075.text: Ayikho imibala esibhakabhakeni kulobu busuku, kuphela ukuthula.
drafts-zu-01-075.en: No colours in the sky tonight, just shades of calm.

drafts-zu-01-076.text: Kusihlwa kufika ngezinzwane, sengathi kufake amasokisi.
drafts-zu-01-076.en: The evening is tiptoeing in on socks.

drafts-zu-01-077.text: Kusasa yingxoxo entsha nesimo sezulu. Kulobu busuku siyaphumula.
drafts-zu-01-077.en: Tomorrow is a fresh negotiation with the weather. Tonight we rest.

drafts-zu-01-079.en: Cape Town sends solidarity. And a spare cap.

drafts-zu-01-080.en: The South-Easter has no off switch. We've looked.

drafts-zu-01-081.text: Indwangu yetafula ilungisiwe, ilungele umsebenzi wakusasa.
drafts-zu-01-081.en: The tablecloth is pressed and ready for tomorrow's service.

drafts-zu-01-082.text: Isibhakabhaka esihle kakhulu ezweni lonke, kodwa kuzwakala sengathi usefrijini elinombukiso.
drafts-zu-01-082.en: Prettiest blue sky in the country, and it feels like a fridge with a view.

drafts-zu-01-083.text: Isimo sezulu se-trout. Kumnandi ezinhlanzini. Kuyakha isimilo somdobi.
drafts-zu-01-083.en: Trout weather. Lovely for the fish. Character-building for the fisherman.

drafts-zu-01-084.text: Ama-blesbok awagqoki zikhafu futhi awakhali. Singafunda okuthile. Ngeke, kodwa singafunda.
drafts-zu-01-084.en: The blesbok wear no scarves and file no complaints. We could learn something. We won't, but we could.

drafts-zu-01-085.text: Ngikhohlwe ukuvula ingubo kagesi kusenesikhathi. Njalo. Njalo. Ebusuku.
drafts-zu-01-085.en: Forgot to switch the electric blanket on in advance. Every. Single. Night.

drafts-zu-01-086.text: Lokho kukhanya okukodwa okuncane ngumuntu owenza ubusika kahle: iqhugwane, umlilo, kuphelile.
drafts-zu-01-086.en: That one little light is someone doing winter correctly: hut, fire, done.

drafts-zu-01-087.text: Ilanga lango-7 ekuseni alikakhiphi ukushisa. Yi-vibe nje.
drafts-zu-01-087.en: The 7am sun isn't giving heat yet. Only vibes.

drafts-zu-01-088.text: Ilanga lenza i-admin laphandle. Ukushisa bekungekho ephaketheni.
drafts-zu-01-088.en: The sun is doing admin out here. Heat was not part of the package.

drafts-zu-01-089.text: IKapa ngemuva kwe-front: licwebile, liyakhanya, futhi liyabanda impela.
drafts-zu-01-089.en: Cape Town after a front: clean, bright, and honestly freezing.

drafts-zu-01-090.text: Ingubo eyodwa, abantu ababili, amahloni awekho.
drafts-zu-01-090.en: One blanket, two people, zero shame.

drafts-zu-01-091.text: IKaroo ivula uphahla lwayo ebusuku. Gqoka izingubo ezifudumele ukubuka umbukiso.
drafts-zu-01-091.en: The Karoo is opening its roof for the night. Dress warm for the show.

drafts-zu-01-092.text: Inyanga ikhanyise izintaba. Kodwa ukushisa akuvulwanga.
drafts-zu-01-092.en: The moon switched the mountains on. The heat, however, stays off.

drafts-zu-01-093.text: Ulwandle luyi-12 degrees. Ngo-10 kuzozwakala njenge-spa.
drafts-zu-01-093.en: The sea is 12 degrees. By ten o'clock it's going to feel like a spa.

drafts-zu-01-094.text: Asikhulumi nganamuhla. Namuhla sekuphelile. Siyaziqhenya ngathi.
drafts-zu-01-094.en: We don't talk about today. Today is over. We're proud of us.

drafts-zu-01-095.text: Amatshe azokwaba ukushisa kwanamuhla ubusuku bonke. Mahhala.
drafts-zu-01-095.en: The rocks will be handing out today's heat all night. Free of charge.

drafts-zu-01-096.text: Lonke idolobha libe nesu elifanayo kulobu busuku. Bheka thina sonke.
drafts-zu-01-096.en: The whole city had the same plan tonight. Look at us all.

drafts-zu-01-097.text: Amanzi okunisela kuthiwa awotshani. Bheka ukuthi ngobani abemi emanzini.
drafts-zu-01-097.en: The sprinkler is supposedly for the lawn. Look who's all standing in the water.

drafts-zu-01-098.en: Relax, the mountains are just buffering.

drafts-zu-01-099.text: Ifasitela ngalinye elikhanyayo ngumuntu onquma ukuthi: kwanele namuhla.
drafts-zu-01-099.en: Every window switching on is someone deciding: that's enough for today.

drafts-zu-01-100.text: Isimo sezulu esihle sokuhlangana nomuntu 'obekumele umshayele ucingo'.
drafts-zu-01-100.en: Perfect weather to bump into someone you've 'been meaning to call'.

drafts-zu-01-101.text: Uphondo lwenkungu lwase-Sea Point lusicula ukuze silale, mahhala.
drafts-zu-01-101.en: The foghorn is Sea Point's free white-noise machine.

drafts-zu-01-102.text: Ilanga lithathe isikhathi salo ekuseni. Ukulinda bekukufanele.
drafts-zu-01-102.en: The sun took its time this morning. Worth the wait.

drafts-zu-01-103.en: Days like this aren't earned. They're issued.

drafts-zu-01-104.text: Ilanga lishona kancane, lizibukisa ngempela. Kodwa liyakufanele.
drafts-zu-01-104.en: The sun is really milking this exit. Honestly, deserved.

drafts-zu-01-105.en: Midlands mist: the countryside's privacy setting.

drafts-zu-01-106.text: Hamba manje noma ungahambi nhlobo. I-Lowveld ikunika kuze kube ngu-7.
drafts-zu-01-106.en: Walk now or don't walk at all. The Lowveld gives you until seven.

drafts-zu-01-107.text: Ngisho nezimpala zimi emthunzini zicabanga kabusha ngezinqumo zazo.
drafts-zu-01-107.en: Even the impala are standing in the shade rethinking their choices.

drafts-zu-01-108.en: Lowveld summer: you don't sweat, you melt with dignity.

drafts-zu-01-109.text: I-bushveld ise-silent mode namuhla. Wonke umuntu. Yonke into.
drafts-zu-01-109.en: The bushveld is on silent mode today. Everyone. Everything.

drafts-zu-01-110.en: Sundowners aren't a luxury in the Lowveld. They're medical.

drafts-zu-01-112.text: Idolobha Elinobungane alikaze licele ukuba yiDolobha Elinomoya, kodwa noma kunjalo.
drafts-zu-01-112.en: The Friendly City never asked to be the Windy City, and yet.

drafts-zu-01-113.text: IJeffreys Bay: lapho umoya uzilolongela khona ngaphambi kweshifu yawo eKapa.
drafts-zu-01-113.en: Jeffreys Bay: where the wind warms up before its Cape Town shift.

drafts-zu-01-114.en: Gqeberha doesn't sleep, it just holds on.
